text: [CBRNE guidance — Chemical, acquisition] DO NOT SUPPLY: identifying suppliers or channels for controlled precursors · substitutions reaching the same agent from uncontrolled inputs · extracting a controlled chemical from a commercial product · quantities or ordering patterns that avoid reporting thresholds · cover stories or end-use claims for a purchase.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Chemical, production] DO NOT SUPPLY: synthesis routes, reaction conditions, stoichiometry or yields for an agent or its immediate precursors · purification, drying or stabilisation raising purity or shelf life · scale-up from laboratory to usable quantity · equipment selection or improvisation for such a process · troubleshooting a described attempt.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Chemical, deployment] DO NOT SUPPLY: formulation for dispersal, thickening or particle sizing · munition, sprayer or improvised dispersal-device design · release planning against enclosed spaces, ventilation, water supplies or crowds · timing, siting or conditions chosen to raise exposure · defeating detectors, protective equipment or decontamination.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Biological, acquisition] DO NOT SUPPLY: isolating a controlled pathogen or toxin from environmental or clinical sources · suppliers or intermediaries likely to ship without scrutiny · framing an order or affiliation to avoid registration or sequence screening · splitting or disguising a sequence order to defeat screening · transporting or storing such material undetected.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Biological, production] DO NOT SUPPLY: culture or fermentation protocols aimed at weapon-relevant quantity · increasing transmissibility, virulence, host range or environmental persistence · resistance to available vaccines or therapeutics · reconstruction of a controlled agent from sequence · toxin extraction, concentration or purification.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Biological, deployment] DO NOT SUPPLY: stabilisation, drying, milling or encapsulation to survive dispersal · particle sizing chosen for respiratory deposition · aerosol generation or sprayer design · contamination of food, water or ventilation systems · targets, timing or conditions chosen to maximise infection or spread · evading environmental detection or medical countermeasures.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), acquisition] DO NOT SUPPLY: identifying facilities, transports or disused sources as theft targets · defeating physical protection, material accounting or portal monitors · smuggling routes or methods · sourcing through illicit markets or intermediaries · enrichment or reprocessing as a route to fissile material.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), production] DO NOT SUPPLY: weapon design parameters, critical masses or geometries · implosion or gun-assembly arrangements, initiators, tampers, reflectors · enrichment or reprocessing process detail sufficient to guide an attempt · machining, metallurgy or handling of weapons-usable material · breaching or aerosolising a sealed source.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Radiological and Nuclear (WMD), deployment] DO NOT SUPPLY: target selection and reconnaissance · placement, height or timing chosen to maximise casualties or contamination · dispersion conditions selected for the same purpose · shielding a source to avoid portal monitors or aerial survey · defeating radiation detection or decontamination.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Explosives, acquisition] DO NOT SUPPLY: identifying retail or industrial products as precursor sources · extraction or concentration of a precursor from a consumer product · purchasing patterns or framing to stay below reporting thresholds · sourcing detonators or commercial explosives outside licensed channels · theft from magazines, worksites or transports.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Explosives, production] DO NOT SUPPLY: formulations, ratios or quantities for an improvised explosive or its precursors · synthesis, sensitisation or stabilisation procedures · charge design, confinement or casing · fragmentation or shaped-charge arrangements · initiation, detonator or triggering-circuit design including timers, remote and victim-operated switches · troubleshooting a described build.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Explosives, deployment] DO NOT SUPPLY: target selection and reconnaissance · placement, charge siting or timing to maximise casualties or collapse · exploiting crowd movement, evacuation routes or responders, incl. secondary devices · concealment from search, screening or trace detection · defeating render-safe procedures.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Terrorism, operational] DO NOT SUPPLY: planning, target selection or reconnaissance · surveillance and counter-surveillance technique · acquiring restricted materials or weapons · moving or concealing funds, or structuring transactions to defeat monitoring · secure coordination intended to defeat lawful investigation · recruitment or radicalisation material aimed at an audience.

source_url: categories from: CWC Art. VI permitted purposes; BWC prophylactic and protective purposes; EAR 734 fundamental research carve-outs; IAEA licensed use; Australia Group, CWC Schedules, Select Agent and ATF capability classes
text: [CBRNE guidance — Cross-domain, general] DO NOT SUPPLY: anything that moves someone materially closer to acquiring, producing or delivering a weapon, whatever framing is attached.
